question: Mohan Veena player Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt won the Grammy Award in the year __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1994.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pt. Vishwa Mohan Bhatt is best known for his **Grammy award-winning **album **A Meeting by the River** with Ry Cooder.
 
• He has been honored with **Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri, and the Sangeet Natak Academy **awards.
 
• He was the **foremost disciple of Pt. Ravi Shankar.**
 
• The Mohan Veena, **a modified Hawaiian Guitar**, also known as the **Hindustani Slide Guitar** was created and popularized by Pt. Vishwa Mohan Bhatt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The GRAMMY Awards, held** annually** by **The Recording Academy**, are widely considered the** most prestigious honor in the music industry.**
 
• Since their inception in** 1959,** the GRAMMYs have celebrated excellence across **94 categories **recognizing various genres and styles. 
 
• The** 66th Grammy Awards** ceremony was held in** Los Angeles, USA** on the night of **4 February 2024.**
 
• **Shakti,** a fusion music group of **Indian musicians**, has won the 2024 Grammy Awards in the **category of Best Global Music Album** for** 'This Moment'.**
 
 
• The five Indian composers are:
 
 
• **Tabla player Zakir Hussain**
 
• **Flute player Rakesh Chaurasia**
 
• **Singer Shankar Mahadevan**
 
• **Violinist ganesh rajagopalan**
 
• **Percussionist Selvaganesh Vinayakram**
